content.text: {"id": "mm5941a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Although 47 (92%) of 51 Medicaid programs offered coverage for some form of tobacco-dependence treatment"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "coverage for any tobacco-dependence treatments increased, from 45 programs"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Coverage for all Medicaid enrollees was reported for the nicotine patch (34 programs)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 51 Medicaid programs, 47 provided tobacco-dependence treatment coverage for some enrollees"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the 51 Medicaid programs, 47 provided tobacco-dependence treatment coverage for some enrollees"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "16 programs reported coverage for fee-for-service enrollees that differed from that provided for Medicaid managed-care enrollees"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "coverage for any tobacco-dependence treatments increased, from 45 programs"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "To monitor progress toward that objective, the Center for Health and Public Policy Studies"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "coverage for any tobacco-dependence treatments increased, from 45 programs"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 47 programs that indicated they covered at least one tobacco-dependence treatment, supporting documentation was obtained for 44 (94%) programs."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "For programs without complete documentation, the information given by the respondent was confirmed with a second respondent within that state"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Coverage for all enrollees was defined as coverage that did not differ between fee-for-service (FFS) and managed-care organization (MCO) enrollees."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
